method: For every >50%-hand-skinned actual vertex, intersect anatomical +Z ray against actual posed torso triangles; compare z with front/back intersections. No z percentile surrogate.
limitations: Torso patch open at neck/waist, so only rays with >=2 separated skin intersections classified.
Checks skin-skin overlap only; no cloth mesh/contact simulation.
Positive anterior clearance is not proof of original-photo hand gesture.
